tree.heading: Commissioner
tree.text: The term “Commissioner” means the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection of the Department of Homeland Security.

tree.heading: Maquiladora
tree.text: The term “maquiladora” means an entity located in Mexico that assembles and produces goods from imported parts for export to the United States.

tree.heading: Northern border
tree.text: The term “northern border” means the international border between the United States and Canada.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security.

tree.heading: Southern border
tree.text: The term “southern border” means the international border between the United States and Mexico.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 110–161, div. E, title VI, § 601, Dec. 26, 2007, 121 Stat. 2094, provided that: “This title [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘Border Infrastructure and Technology Modernization Act of 2007’.”
